reply_text:
I've replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I told him I'm treating "Gate 34" as an unconfirmed rumour and won't pass it on as the Marlowe site.

I didn't find anything that confirms it. I searched the knowledge brain and only looked at what Hollis himself can see. None of that mentions a Marlowe rollout or a Gate 34 for Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Quarrendon is a North team account, and the public notes show Dana Okafor took it over in June 2025. So I pointed Hollis to Dana or Ilse Varga, the North team lead, to confirm the real site. Thea Ramaswell is the main contact on Quarrendon's side.

There's also a #inc-qfl-sev1 channel, but Hollis isn't a member, so I didn't read it for him.
